text: the care of: Heb. the business
salute thee: Heb. ask thee of peace
let it be when these signs are come unto thee: Heb. and it shall come to pass that when these signs etc. | that thou do as occasion serve thee: Heb. do for thee as thine hand shall find
back: Heb. shoulder | gave: Heb. turned
one to another: Heb. a man to his neighbor
of the same place: Heb. from thence
God save the King: Heb. let the king live
he held his peace: Or, he was, as though he had been deaf
